about: The vision of the Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) is to cultivate a dynamic and innovative environment that fosters excellence in education, research, and technological advancement. We aim to equip our students with the knowledge and skills necessary to thrive in a rapidly evolving digital world, encouraging critical thinking, creativity, and a commitment to lifelong learning. Our department is dedicated to pioneering cutting-edge research that addresses contemporary challenges and contributes to societal progress.

The Department offers a comprehensive B.Tech. program in Mechanical Engineering that provides students with the flexibility to pursue minors in a wide range of interdisciplinary fields, thereby equipping them with a broader perspective and diverse skill set to meet the evolving demands of industry and research. At the postgraduate level, the Department offers specialized M.Tech. programs in Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanics & Design, Thermal & Fluids Engineering, and Computational Mechanics, each designed to provide in-depth knowledge, advanced technical expertise, and research-oriented learning opportunities. The faculty members are organized into three core groups – Design, Manufacturing, and Thermal. Within these groups, the Department actively engages in cutting-edge research and development in several prominent areas, including Additive Manufacturing technologies, Bio-Mechanical Engineering applications, Energy Efficiency and Sustainability solutions, Intelligent Mechanical Systems, and Micro/Nano Engineered Systems.

Department imparts the knowledge in three programs, a Bachelors programme with a total intake of 60 students per academic year, a Master of Technology and a Doctoral (Ph.D.) programme to upskill technical and research excellence in specialized avenues of Electrical Engineering.

The Civil Engineering department came into existence in 2016 in a rather modest way with three faculty members, 25 B.Tech.Students, and one Ph.D. student. The Department has evolved significantly since then on all fronts. The faculty strength has risen to 15, and the number of B.Tech.Students have increased to 158, and the number of Ph.D. scholars in the Department has been increased to 55. The Department has also started two years of master’s programs to offer M.Tech. in Water Resources and Environment and M.Tech. in Structural Engineering and Geomechanics.

Department of Chemistry
The department of chemistry was established in 2009 to conduct cutting edge interdisciplinary research and impart high quality education in emerging areas of Chemical Science. The department was started with only four faculty members and three PhD students, and has grown significantly in last 14 years. It has 15 regular faculty and has more than eighty PhD students and 8 Post-doctoral fellows.

The department has active research programs in emerging areas like Biomaterials, Biosensors, Catalysis, Drug Delivery, Materials, Organometallic Chemistry, Renewable Energy, Supramolecular Syntheses, Synthetic Organic Chemistry, Theoretical Chemistry, Ultracold Chemistry, etc. The research activities at the department are supported by state-of-the-art research facilities. The department has received funding through several sponsored national and international research projects.

As a Department of Humanities and Social Sciences (HSS) in an Indian Institute of Technology that sets international parameters of academic excellence, this particular department strives to demonstrate its uniqueness and relevance to the vision of an IIT. The thrust of HSS is of course wedded to the visionary remark that Jawaharlal Nehru made while conceptualizing the IITs in the initial years of an independent India: “I know you can measure with your techniques and rules the hardness and strength of this metal or that, of stone and iron and whatnot. … How do you measure the strength of an individual? The human being as material is not only a difficult material but an exciting material because it is a live material, a growing material, a changing and dynamic thing

The School of Artificial Intelligence and Data Engineering (SAIDE) at the Indian Institute of Technology Ropar (IIT Ropar) is at the forefront of advancing artificial intelligence, data engineering, and their interdisciplinary applications. SAIDE offers a comprehensive suite of academic programs, including B.Tech., M.S. by Research, and Ph.D., designed to cultivate innovation, technical expertise, and societal impact.

The Department of Chemical Engineering at IIT Ropar was established in the academic year 2017-18 with the goal of providing engineers with a broad array of talents for the emerging chemical industries in the nation and worldwide. The Department presently offers undergraduate (B.Tech.) and postgraduate (M.Tech., Ph.D.) programs. The Department is a community of outstanding research scholars, experienced educators, and talented students. The faculty members work in the various areas of chemical engineering, such as Catalysis and Reaction Engineering, Energy and Environment, Multiscale Modeling, Soft Matter Engineering, and Transport Phenomena and Thermodynamics.

The Department of Biomedical Engineering (DBME) was established on February 2021 by superseding the Center for Biomedical Engineering (CBME) program, established earlier in May 2013.

 

The main goal of DBME is to meet the challenges of affordable healthcare facing the nation by encouraging research and entrepreneurship in interdisciplinary areas, encompassing engineering, medical sciences, and natural sciences. The center has following focus areas of research: Biomedical Imaging; Medical Devices; Cancer Diagnostics and Therapy; Biomaterials; and Tissue Engineering. Because of the diverse research backgrounds of our faculty, there is a strong thrust on interdisciplinary research at the center. Going forward, the center seeks collaboration with national and international universities/institutes and partnership with industries to realize its goals.

The department of Mathematics was established in 2009 with the mission to advance interdisciplinary research and deliver high-quality education in emerging areas of mathematical sciences. The department is committed to excellence in both teaching and research, encompassing Pure and Applied Mathematics.

The department is also a hub for collaborative research, attracting students and faculty from other institutions for short-term research projects. It also hosts postdoctoral fellows, further enhancing its research capabilities and contributing to its dynamic academic community.

The Department of Metallurgical and Materials Engineering at IIT Ropar was established in November 2017 by upgrading the Center for Materials and Energy Engineering. Currently, the Department of Metallurgical and Materials Engineering offers B.Tech. and PhD programs. The Department has faculty members in all the major areas of Metallurgical and Materials Engineering. The focus areas of the Department are Physical Metallurgy, Extractive Metallurgy, Mechanical Metallurgy, Energy Materials, Functional Materials and related areas.

The Department of Physics at IIT Ropar was established in 2009 with an ambition to pursue high-level teaching methodologies and top-notch research in advanced  areas of experimental & theoretical physics, and interdisciplinary areas of science and technology. Presently, the Department supports the undergraduate program of the institute and offers MSc. and Ph.D. programme in Physics. Our curiosity-driven research programs train young scientists to acquire knowledge and mould them as global leaders in science and technology as well as to communicate and engage with the broader society. The doctoral candidates and postdoctoral fellows are mentored in diverse areas of physical sciences, but are not limited to; flexible nano-structures for renewable energy, ion-beam surface modifications, physics of Graphene and nano-devices, low dimensional strongly correlated electron systems, nonlinear light scattering and interfacial structure of biologically relevant interfaces, nuclear structure and reaction dynamics, astrophysics, neutrino physics, mesoscopic physics and optomechanics, nano-scale optics and meta-materials, quantum optics, quantum information and computing, and quantum gravity and string theory

The Health Center at IIT Ropar is dedicated to promoting the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of all members of the campus community, including students, faculty, and staff. Our mission is to provide accessible, high-quality, and compassionate healthcare services that support the overall health and success of the institute’s members.

We offer a comprehensive range of integrated services such as general medical care for common illnesses and minor injuries, preventive health check-ups and screenings to support long-term wellness, and mental health and counseling services to provide emotional and psychological support. In addition, we conduct health promotion and awareness programs to encourage healthy lifestyle choices and are equipped to provide timely emergency care and first-aid support when needed.

We, along with our colleagues are committed towards making IIT Ropar the R&D powerhouse of the world. R&D section of the institute acts as the conduit for industrial interaction and faculty participation in sponsored research by providing administrative, financial and managerial support for the execution of all research and development projects in the Institute. The primary role is to sense the emerging landscape of various technology domains, prepare and enable the technology roadmap of the institute by interfacing with the industry, various ministries, peer academic institutions, and monitor the execution of the numerous sponsored R&D and consulting activities of the institute.
Research as a theme has always been the center of attention at IIT Ropar. Today, the R&D office has a staff of around 6 maintaining individual accounts of over 100 projects at any given time, processing papers related to purchase, travel, appointment, and salaries.
